SEARCH.TITLE: Find an offer
SEARCH.META_DESCRIPTION: Search for PhD thesis topics and doctoral offers on the national PhD platform. Filter by discipline, location, research laboratory and more.
SEARCH.AI_HINT_DISABLED: Enable natural language search. Thesis subjects are analyzed semantically (title, abstract, keywords…).
SEARCH.AI_HINT_ENABLED: Ask the AI in natural language. Examples: "artificial intelligence health", "theses on climate".
SEARCH.AI_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. What are the PhD topics related to artificial intelligence and health?
SEARCH.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI-based search service is temporarily unavailable. The results below come from the standard keyword-based search.
SEARCH.AI_UNAVAILABLE_HINT: You can also perform a standard search using the filters in the sidebar.
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_HINT: Write your search in natural language, as if you were speaking
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. thesis on artificial intelligence for health
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_AUTRES_RESULTATS: Offers that might also interest you
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_NLP_TITLE: How to formulate a relevant search?
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_NLP_DESC:
Describe the type of topic you are looking for, then add, if needed, at the end of your query and in this order, the location then the funding.
Example: "I am looking for a topic in AI applied to healthcare, particularly in medical imaging, in Marseille, funded by a CIFRE".
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_AMBIGUE: Many relevant results match your query. To refine these results, please specify your topic further.
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_AMBIGUE_ZERO: No result exactly matches your query. Please rephrase or broaden your search to discover more results.
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_LOCATION_NOT_MATCHED: Looking for a specific area? The most relevant results are not located in that zone. You can use the "Location" filter to display only results near the place you are interested in.
SEARCH.SCALEWAY_INTENTS_FILTER_HINT: Click an intention to filter results

INFO.THESE: By exploring the PhD opportunities, PhD projects and mentoring offers available on this platform, you can identify PhD supervisors to collaborate with in developing your own doctoral project. Applications to a doctoral school should only be submitted once the PhD project has been jointly defined.
INFO.SUPERVISION: With a mentoring or partnership offer, researchers indicate that they are interested in supporting PhD candidates on doctoral projects related to specific themes or research questions.
